title: Record the magnitude of dirty helper L359
body:
## Summary
- The F0 scalar fault witness sets dirty helper `L359` to `T` and, immediately before event 24438, sets `L39` to `-4T`.
- The stored instruction adds 4 times `L359` into `L39`. All four stored completed defects equal `4*u*T`, for `T` a power of two equal to 1, 256, `2^64` or `2^256`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The 26,099-event word is not replayed.
